scope: Unified physical-lineage audit of original RGB, DA3, MiniMax-H3, and Qwen3-VL observation sources
summary: The original real 660-frame RGB capture is recovered as one non-metric physical acquisition group; DA3, H3, and both Qwen reports remain model-derived and add zero physical authority.
evidence: Five artifact hashes bind one original real RGB video and four model-derived artifacts.
The audit reports independent_physical_group_count=1 for real-flower-capture-1, but metric_camera=false because no metric calibration passed.
Robot trajectory and contact-force authority are also false; generated observations are machine-rejected from all physical gates.
The output names the exact missing sources: real AprilTag/RGB-D/extra-camera calibration, synchronized exact-asset q/qdot, and sensing or a downstream validated solver.
lessons: A pre-existing real source video can independently supervise visible flower/background motion without proving metric geometry or generated robot contact.
Generative novel views preserve causal lineage and cannot be counted as new cameras even when visually plausible.
limitations: Only one physical RGB acquisition group exists and it has no external scale, depth, telemetry, tactile, or force-torque channel.
The current 27.5-second robot replacement remains PARTIAL.
next_actions: Capture at least one real calibrated RGB-D/AprilTag/extra-camera stream and a second independent calibration group, or synchronized complete q/qdot telemetry, before claiming physical completion.
